WITH joined AS (
  SELECT o.account_id AS order_account_id, d.A3 AS region_name
  FROM "order" AS o
  JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = o.account_id
  JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
),
group_counts AS (
  SELECT order_account_id, region_name, COUNT(*) AS group_count
  FROM joined
  GROUP BY order_account_id, region_name
),
overall_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(group_count) AS avg_count
  FROM group_counts
),
differences AS (
  SELECT g.order_account_id, g.region_name, g.group_count,
         g.group_count - oa.avg_count AS overall_difference
  FROM group_counts AS g
  CROSS JOIN overall_average AS oa
),
regional_averages AS (
  SELECT region_name, AVG(overall_difference) AS regional_average
  FROM differences
  GROUP BY region_name
)
SELECT d.order_account_id, d.region_name, d.group_count,
       d.overall_difference,
       d.overall_difference - r.regional_average AS final_difference
FROM differences AS d
JOIN regional_averages AS r
  ON d.region_name = r.region_name
WHERE d.overall_difference > r.regional_average
ORDER BY final_difference DESC
LIMIT 10
